caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress in a muted grayish-purple color with a fitted bodice and wide, flared sleeves. The dress features decorative black trims with small purple or violet accents on the sleeves and the center front of the bodice. There are three prominent decorative flower-like elements located at the base of the collar, at the center of the chest, and at the waist. The collar is white with detailed lace work. The dress appears to be ankle-length, and the wide skirt flares out from a fitted waist. There is a lighter colored lining visible at the edge of the sleeves, contrasting with the rest of the dress. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a line drawing of the back view of the dress, which shows the overall shape, sleeve length, and placement of the decorative trim, as well as the collar extending to the back and a seam at the waist. The background is a plain beige color.
title: Dress
